Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of West Indies are seen in a huddle near the boundary ropes. Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das will open the batting for Bangladesh. Akeal Hosein will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

West Indies on the other hand would be shocked at their batting display. Shamarh Brooks was the only top-order batter to cross 20 runs as the rest failed to establish themselves at the wicket. The highest partnership was for the last wicket between Jayden Seales and Anderson Phillip who put on an unbeaten 39-run partnership to push West Indies to a total that they can bowl at. That said this should be an easy total for Bangladesh to achieve and if West Indies have any chance of getting back in this game, they will need their bowlers to come out raring and pick some early wickets. Stay tuned for the second innings!

Tamim Iqbal will be thrilled with his boys who justified his decision to bowl first with a disciplined bowling performance. Mehidy Hasan bowled out 9 overs taking 3 crucial wickets and controlled the game for Bangladesh. However, the pick of the bowlers was Shoriful Islam who grabbed a four-fer and kept taking wickets in pairs to keep West Indies consistently on the back foot. If there is one thing the visitors will be disappointed about, it will be their catching. They dropped numerous catches and had they taken all their chances this game would have been much easier for them.

What a brilliant performance by Bangladesh with the only blip being that they could not wrap up the West Indies innings. On the back of disappointing losses in the Test series and the T20I series, credit must be given to them for putting up such a dominating performance in this first ODI.

Outside off, on a length. Anderson Phillip dabs it towards point and runs across for a run. There is a throw towards the bowler, but it was well away from him. Another run taken! West Indies end at 149 for 9!

Outstanding effort! Another length ball, around middle. Anderson Phillip once again heaves this towards deep mid-wicket. Litton Das takes a brilliant catch while running to his right. He realizes he is crossing the boundary ropes and throws the ball back into play. Two taken!
SIX! KABOOM! Something to cheer about for the fans! A fuller ball, around middle. Anderson Phillip clears his front leg and dispatches this one over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Full and around middle. Jayden Seales knocks it towards long on for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle. Anderson Phillip slogs this away towards long on for a single.
On a length, around middle. Anderson Phillip blocks it out.
Shorter one, outside off. Jayden Seales dabs it towards backward point.
Shorter ball, slower as well, around off. Jayden Seales leans back and tries to cut this but he fails to get any bat to it.

Tight single! Direct hit would have curtains for Anderson Phillip! A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Anderson Phillip flicks to mid-wicket and sets off to the other end. Mehidy Hasan collects the ball and has a shy at non-striker's end but he misses.
An off-cutter, around off, fuller one. Anderson Phillip looks to drive but he gets a slight inside edge back onto the pads.

A fuller ball, takes the pace off this one, around middle and leg. Jayden Seales tries to flick this but he misses and gets pinged on his pad. A huge shout for an LBW, but the umpire says no!  Bangladesh opt for a review! Nothing on UltraEdge! Ball Tracking shows that pitching outside leg. Not Out it is! Also, the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Outside off, on a length. Anderson Phillip dabs it off the back foot towards cover and takes a single.
Taskin Ahmed come to bowl the penultimate over!
Mustafizur Rahman ends the over with a fullish delivery outside off, Anderson Phillip knocks this towards mid off for a single
Good-length delivery outside off, Jayden Seales works this towards the point region for a single.

Dropped once again! Bangladesh will be really disappointed with their fielding performance! Mustafizur Rahman bowls a slower delivery angled in from outside off, Jayden Seales steps across and lofts it towards mid-wicket. Afif Hossain runs towards the ball and dives forward to get a hold of it. Makes a complete mess off it and another chance goes begging for Bangladesh as they look to wrap up this innings.
Full toss outside off once more and this Jayden Seales does not get bat to it.
Mustafizur Rahman serves a low full toss outside off stump, Jayden Seales works this past point to get a couple of runs.
Slower delivery from a good length and pitching on leg. Anderson Phillip guides this towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle and off. Anderson Phillip knocks it to long off for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jayden Seales dabs it with soft hands towards cover. Single taken!
On a length now, down the leg side. Anderson Phillip works it away towards square leg and takes a run.
Full and onto the pads. Jayden Seales flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, slower ball, fullish one. Jayden Seales misses his push, he gets undone by lack of pace.

Put down! Another dropped catch! Mahmudullah is the culprit this time.A slower ball, length, around middle. Jayden Seales lifts this one towards long off. Mahmudullah runs forward, gets under the ball, manages to get his hands to it but he spills it out in the end. Two taken! Shoriful Islam had a chance to get a five-fer here!
Another play and a miss! Slower, fuller and outside off. Anderson Phillip once again gets beaten while trying to drive this one.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, slower ball. Anderson Phillip leans to drive but he misses.
Outside off, fuller one, a tad slower. Jayden Seales slog-sweeps this one away from the fielder at long on for a single.
A yorker now, on middle. Jayden Seales does well to dig this one out.
Slower ball, outside off. Anderson Phillip leans to drive but the ball goes off his outside edge towards point for a single.
A low full toss, around off. Jayden Seales knocks it down to long off and takes a single.
A fuller one, around middle. Jayden Seales looks to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge over the bowler's head. Only a single!
No run.
Shoriful Islam hits the deck hard now serves a short one, around middle. Jayden Seales ducks underneath it.
On a length, outside off. Jayden Seales pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Nothing off the Free Hit! A shorter ball, slower one, outside off. Jayden Seales looks to pull this one but he fails to get any bat on it.
No ball! A length ball, on the thigh pads. Jayden Seales tucks it towards fine leg and takes a couple of runs! Shoriful Islam has overstepped here and a no ball is calleed! Free Hit coming up!
Outside off, a length ball. Jayden Seales taps it to the fielder at point.
An off-cutter, outside off, fullish ball. Anderson Phillip fails to keep this one out as well.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, slower one, width on offer as well. Anderson Phillip tries to cut this away but he misses.
Another off pace delivery, outside off, fullish ball. Anderson Phillip once again gets beaten.
Slower one, outside off, fuller one. Anderson Phillip gets beaten while trying to drive this one.

In the air...and put down! Another opportunity goes down! A slower one, full, around middle. Anderson Phillip heaves this towards the leg side. But the ball goes off the top edge and in the vacant mid-wicket regions. Mustafizur Rahman runs and covers a lot of ground there. He dives forward, but he only manages to get his fingers on the ball. Two taken!
A length ball, darting it on the pads. Anderson Phillip looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit high on his thigh pads.
Full delivery outside off, Anderson Phillip drags this towards mid-wicket for a single. Shoriful Islam completes another wonderful over that gets him two wickets!
Shoriful Islam goes full and angles it into middle and leg, Jayden Seales works this towards fine leg for a single.
Jayden Seales is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Shoriful Islam gets another wicket in the over and West Indies are now 9 down! Shoriful Islam is one away from grabbing his five-wicket haul! Coming to the ball - this was shortish, and outside off. Gudakesh Motie stays in his crease and slashes this straight to the fielder at backward point. Mehidy Hasan pouches it safely. Gudakesh Motie departs!
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Slower delivery bowled full and outside off. Gudakesh Motie is watchful as he lets this one through for the keeper to collect.
On a good length outside off. Shoriful Islam bowls it slower in the air and beats Gudakesh Motie for pace.
Anderson Phillip comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! The last recongnized batter falls for West Indies! Romario Shepherd was looking to get a move on but hauls out to the deep fielder. Shoriful Islam has bowled wonderfully this game as he pitches this full outside off. Romario Shepherd stays back in the crease and hits it hard but mistimes the slower delivery high up into the sky. There is not enough distance in the shot and Afif Hossain at deep mid-wicket takes a well judged catch. West Indies have lost their way in this innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Time for Powerplay 3!
An off pace delivery, outside off, on a length. Romario Shepherd taps it to point and takes a run. He retains the strike!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Romario Shepherd dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller this time, on the pads. Gudakesh Motie flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, slower one, on a length. Gudakesh Motie tries to slash this away but he misses.

Put down! Some luck favouring West Indies here! A fuller ball, outside off. Gudakesh Motie heaves this one towards long on. He manages to get only elevation on that and no distance. Shoriful Islam runs forward, settles under the catch, and gets his hands to it but he spills it out in the end. Two taken! The crowd loves it!
Tight single! A length ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd taps it towards cover and scampers across to the other end.
Taskin Ahmed continues bowling short to Gudakesh Motie but this is outside off and the batter is happy to leave it alone.
Shorter delivery outside off. Gudakesh Motie hits this straight to the point fielder.

Full delivery angled into the pads, Romario Shepherd looks to work this leg side but misses the line and rolls off his pads towards third man. Romario Shepherd takes a run and its been called leg bye by the umpire.

FOUR! Romario Shepherd is far more equipped to deal with the short ball! Taskin Ahmed bangs this one into the pitch and angles it into the batter. Romario Shepherd gets a hold of this and thumps it through mid-wicket for a welcome boundary!

It almost works! Taskin Ahmed goes short once again and angles this away from the left-hander. Gudakesh Motie goes to pull and get a top edge that goes really high and falls in the vacant long on region. They take three runs as the mid on fielder runs back to collect it just before the boundary. That is 100 for the West Indies!
Taskin Ahmed begins with a short ball aimed at Gudakesh Motie. He ducks under this one. Taskin Ahmed seems to want to intimidate the debutant!
Beaten! Slower one on this occasion, outside off, fuller one. Romario Shepherd looks to drive this but he gets beaten due to lack of pace.
On a length, outside off. Gudakesh Motie taps it towards point for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bull's eye! Another one bites the dust! It's Mehidy Hasan with that throw. A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Romario Shepherd stays in his crease and dabs it towards point. He scampers across to the other end. Mehidy Hasan runs forward, grabs the ball with his right hand, and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The replay shows that Akeal Hosein is just short of his ground. He has to walk back! Gudakesh Motie walks out to bat on his ODI debut.
Width on offer now, shortish ball. Akeal Hosein cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Beaten on this occasion! Another length ball, shaping away a tad, outside off, at 134 clicks. Akeal Hosein hangs back and tries to block this but he misses.
A length ball, angling in, around middle and off, at 130 clicks. Akeal Hosein shuffles across and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on!
Wide outside off from a shorter length. Akeal Hosein mistimes it towards third man for a single.
WIDE! Bangs this in short but gets his radar off as it goes down leg side. The umpire declares its wide and Taskin Ahmed will have to bowl that again.
Taskin Ahmed goes full this time outside off, Akeal Hosein hits the hard to mid off.
Short delivery served leg side. Akeal Hosein leaves it alone awkwardly.

Good-length delivery once again just outside off, Akeal Hosein shows very less foot movement as he hits this towards mid off. There is a direct hit at the non-strikers end and the umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays show that Romario Shepherd has his foot over the line and is safe.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off. Akeal Hosein fends this towards cover-point.
On a good length outside off, Akeal Hosein uses his wrists and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Taskin Ahmed (5-0-14-0) comes back into the attack.
Full, once again on the stumps. Romario Shepherd pushes it back to the bowler.
Attacks the stumps this time, fullish ball. Romario Shepherd gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he gets a slight inside edge back onto his pads.
Quicker, outside off, shorter one. Romario Shepherd tries to cut this away but he misses.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Romario Shepherd pushes it off the back foot to the fielder at cover.
Full again, around the leg pole. Akeal Hosein advances down the pitch and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He gets off the mark!
Outside off, spinning away, outside off. Romario Shepherd drives it towards cover for a single.
Shorter, around middle. Akeal Hosein blocks it out.
Full, loopy one, around middle. Akeal Hosein pushes it back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein is the new batter in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Mehidy Hasan sends the skipper of West Indies back in the hut. He grabs his third wicket and West Indies are now 6 down! A shorter ball, not much turn there, around off. Nicholas Pooran rocks back and tries to cut this away, but he gets cramped for room there and ends up missing it. The ball goes on to hit the off pole.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Nicholas Pooran dabs it towards point.
Shorter one, around middle. Romario Shepherd tucks it towards square leg for a single.

In the air...and just short! A full ball, spinning in, around middle. Romario Shepherd gets down on his knee and sweeps it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs forward and attempts for a catch there but the ball falls just short of him there. Two taken!

FOUR! Nicholas Pooran wants to celebrate his wicket now! Nurul Hasan goes full outside off, Nicholas Pooran charges down the wicket and thumps this over mid off for a lovely boundary! Will this break the shackles?

What a lifeline for Nicholas Pooran! Nasum Ahmed delivers this on full and angling into the pads. Nicholas Pooran comes across the stumps, tries to work this fine but misses the line of the delivery and gets hit on the pad. The Bangladesh players go up in appeal as Nicholas Pooran takes off for a single. The umpire raises his finger slowly and just for good measure they get Nicholas Pooran run out who is stranded halfway down the pitch. Nicholas Pooran decides to review the decision. UltraEdge shows that there is no inside edge but Ball Tracking comes to Nicholas Pooran's rescue as it shows that the ball would be missing the leg stump. The umpire is made to reverse his decision and since the onfield decision was given before the run out happened, that event gets nullified as the ball will count dead after that! Nicholas Pooran will be thanking his stars!

FOUR! Some ordinary fielding from Bangladesh! Flights this one and delivers it full on the pads, Nicholas Pooran charges down the wicket and hits this towards deep square leg. Two fielders are converging on the ball and neither of them is able to stop it. Much needed boundary for West Indies.
Slightly short and outside off, Romario Shepherd punches this down to long off for a single.
Goes full in line of the stumps. Nicholas Pooran sweeps this to deep square leg for a single.
Full-length delivery pitching outside off and turning in. Hits Nicholas Pooran on the the thigh pad as he tries to work it away.
The debutant Nasum Ahmed (6-3-4-0) comes into bowl.

FOUR! Romario Shepherd gets off the mark in style! Tosses this one up, full, around middle and off. Romario Shepherd dances down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary. End of another successful over for Bangladesh.
Loopy one, around middle. Romario Shepherd presses forward and blocks it out watchfully this time.
Fuller, around middle. Romario Shepherd defends this aerially but the ball falls short of Mehidy Hasan!

DRINKS! Bangladesh are all over West Indies here! West Indies are not only losing wickets but are also not able to score runs freely. Bangladesh showing why they enjoy this format so much as they have executed all their plans to perfection. Romario Shepherd is the new man in and will want to justify his selection by digging his team out of trouble.

OUT! LBW! Mehidy Hasan strikes and he gets rid of Rovman Powell! Another huge wicket for Bangladesh. West Indies have now lost half their side. Hasan pulls his length slightly back this time, spinning in, around middle and leg. Rovman Powell rocks back and tries to flick this one on the leg side. But he misses and gets rapped on his front pad. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Rovman Powell opts for a review immediately. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates three reds and Rovman Powell has to walk back.

Excellent fielding! Fuller this time, around middle. Rovman Powell steps down the track and heaves it towards square leg. The fielder there runs to his right, dives and makes a terrific stop. Two taken!
Spinning away, shorter ball. Nicholas Pooran pushes this off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Goes full this time outside off. Nicholas Pooran guides this to the right of mid off for a single.
Shoriful Islam is bowling good length here as this is delivered just outside off. Nicholas Pooran knocks this towards cover.
Serves this on a good length outside off, Nicholas Pooran hits this towards point and some good fielding prevents a single.
Back of a length this time and in line with the stumps. Nicholas Pooran fends this towards cover.
Goes a fraction fuller outside off, Rovman Powell looks to guide this through point but gets a thickish edge towards third man for a single.

Shoriful Islam is in the middle of a good spell here! Bangs this in short and towards the batter, Rovman Powell pulls and gets a top edge that goes wide of the deep square leg fielder. Some good running as the batters complete a couple of runs.

Beaten this time! A shorter one, this one lands around off and spins away. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge. Good over for West Indies, 7 runs off it!
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Nicholas Pooran punches it off the back foot towards deep cover for a brace.
Shorter now, spinning away, around off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! Much-needed boundary for West Indies! Loopy ball, full, around off. Nicholas Pooran gets down on his knee and rever-sweeps this past point for a boundary.
Fullish in length, around middle. Rovman Powell works it away towards square leg for a single.
A huge appeal for LBW but the umpire disagrees! A fuller one, spinning this down the leg side. Rovman Powell lunges forward and tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.

Shoriful Islam serves this full and outside off, takes a little pace off the delivery. Rovman Powell goes for the booming loft over covers but only manages a thick outside edge that falls just short of the third man fielder. Gets across for a single and will think he is lucky to still be there.
This one is angled into the pads from a good length. Nicholas Pooran tries to play this leg side but only mananges to hit his pads and roll towards the vacant square leg region for a leg bye.
On a good length and outside off, Rovman Powell knocks this through point for a single.
Full once again and wide outside off, Rovman Powell reaches for it and misses as it goes through to the keeper.

Goes full this time in line with the stumps. Nicholas Pooran taps this towards mid on and rushes across for a single. There is an attemot made at the non-strikers end but the ball misses and the run is completed.
Shoriful Islam begins by banging one in short and angled into the batter. Rovman Powell pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
This one comes in, full, around middle. Nicholas Pooran looks to drive this but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards the bowler.
Another loopy one, full in length, around off. Nicholas Pooran steers it towards point.
Full, around off. Nicholas Pooran leans and taps it towards point.
Sharp turn there! Tosses this one up, full, spinning away, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out off the back foot.
Shorter ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pushes it back to the bowler.

No hat-trick for Shoriful Islam but this one was really close! Shoriful Islam delivers this full and attacking the pads, Rovman Powell tries to flick this leg side and misses. Gets hit hard on the pads and the Bangladesh players appeal loudly. The umpire remains unmoved and Tamim Iqbal does not choose to review. Mostly pitching outside leg or even going down leg. This will be a double-wicket maiden for Shoriful Islam!
Rovman Powell comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Two in two for Shoriful Islam! What an over this is turning out to be. Another set batter walks back to the hut. A shorter ball, wide of off. Shamarh Brooks rocks back and tries to slash this away but he manages only a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Nurul Hasan takes an easy catch, Shoriful Islam is on a hat-trick! West Indies slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: The skipper of West Indies, Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure had been built and Brandon King succumbs to it! Shoriful Islam serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Brandon King tries to loft this leg side to release some pressure but manages a leading-edge that flies high up in the air. Anamul Haque (sub) positions himself nicely under this one at mid off and takes a comfortable catch. West Indies are just not able to let loose here!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Anamul Haque b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Shoriful Islam bowls this one beautifully! A slower bouncer aimed at the batter, Brandon King tries to pull but plays all over it and is beaten by the pace.
Good-length delivery outside off, Brandon King fends this off solidly.
Shoriful Islam begins with a slower delivery, full and outside off, Brandon King goes for the shot and is beaten on the outside edge.
Shoriful Islam (1-0-2-0) comes back into the attack.
Short and width on offer this time. Brandon King slashes this towards point for a run. He retains the strike!
Back of a length, outside off. Brandon King pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Outside off, fuller ball. Shamarh Brooks leans to drive but the ball goes off his outside edge over point for a single.

A huge appeal for caught behind, but the umpire says no! A shortish ball, shaping away, outside off. Shamarh Brooks stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses. The players from Bangladesh seem confident and they opt for a review! UltraEdge shows no spike as the ball passes through the bat. Shamarh Brooks survives and Bangladesh lose a review!
An overpitched delivery this time from over the wicket, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives this through cover for a brace.
A length ball from 'round the wicket, angling in, around middle. Brandon King works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short once again and just outside off, Shamarh Brooks in better control as he fends this towards point. That ends a long over from Taskin Ahmed.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Shamarh Brooks decides to pull this leg side but the shot selection is really poor. He is nowhere near the ball as it goes through to the keeper.
WIDE! Low full toss wide from off stump. Shamarh Brooks knows this is too far and will be called wide.
Fuller in length and angled in from outside off, Shamarh Brooks tries to play this offside but only manages an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Slightly back of a length and angled into the pads, Brandon King tucks this towards backward square leg for a single.
WIDE! Taskin Ahmed gets his radar all wrong here! Bangs this into the wicket and really wide from off stump. The umpire calls it wide and it could be for both width and height!
This one is full outside off, Shamarh Brooks guides this easily through cover-point for a single.
Taskin Ahmed delivers this on a good length and angling into off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this towards backward point and looks for a single. Brandon King sends him back.
Tad slower now, outside off, on a length. Brandon King taps it towards point. Just 1 run off the over!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Brandon King pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Play and a miss! On a length, this one lands around off and shapes away. Brandon King stays in his crease and tries to slash this one but he fails to get any bat to it.
An overpitched delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives towards cover and takes a quick single.
Good-length delivery, angling in, on middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out solidly.
Fuller ball, outside off, ar 133 clicks. Shamarh Brooks dabs it to the fielder at point.
Mustafizur Rahman (1-0-9-1) comes back to bowl.
Length ball, wide outside off and bowled much slower. Brandon King swings his bat and misses the ball as he is beaten on pace.
Taskin Ahmed continues bowling outside off this time from a good length. Shamarh Brooks works this late towards deep backward point for another single.
Short delivery once again wide from off stump, Brandon King powers this to deep cover point for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Brandon King hits it hard towards extra cover and there is a half stop but they do not take a single.
Bangs this one short and way outside off, Brandon King slashes wildly and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Taskin Ahmed serves this on a good length outside off, Shamarh Brooks plays it late and guides it towards deep backward point for a single.
This one spins, around the leg pole, fullish ball. Brandon King tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pads. Another top over from Mehidy Hasan!
Swing and a miss! Outside off, tad shorter, extra bounce there as well. Brandon King tries to cut this away but he misses.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Brandon King pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it towards long on for a single.
Beaten! Much quicker this time, at 94 clicks, full and outside off. Shamarh Brooks gets beaten while trying to block this one.
Tad quicker at 88 clicks, full, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out solidly.
This one is full and angled into off stump, Brandon King hits this firmly towards cover.
Good-length delivery pitching outside off, Brandon King mistimes his short towards mid on.
Taskin Ahmed goes full and angles it into the pads, Shamarh Brooks plays it with soft hands towards mid on and rushes across for a single.
Slightly back of a length and outside off, Brandon King stands tall and punches it to the left of the cover fielder for a single.
On a good length and just outside off, Brandon King defends this solidly back down the pitch.
Taskin Ahmed serves this full outside off, Shamarh Brooks works this through covers for a single.

DRINKS! A perfect start for Bangladesh after winning the toss. The bowlers have a stranglehold on the West Indies batters at the moment as they are just not able to score freely. Two wickets have fallen and there may have a third but the third umpire thought otherwise. West Indies have a lot of work to do and will be hoping that the partnership between Shamarh Brooks and Brandon King takes them to a better position. Bangladesh will continue with what they are doing and will look for some more wickets. Taskin Ahmed will begin proceedings after Drinks.
Full again, on the pads this time. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards square leg. The fielder there fumbles and the batters steal in a single.
Shorter on this occasion, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, full in length. Brandon King pushes it down to long on for a single.
Edgy runs! Full, outside off, loopy one. Brandon King steps down the track and looks to hit it over cover but the ball goes off his outside edge and over cover-point. Two taken!
Quicker, a low full toss, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it to long on for a single.
Tosses it up, full, arounnd middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Nasum Ahmed goes a fraction fuller and turns this in from outside off, Brandon King works this towards the cover fielder.
Slightly short and outside off, Brandon King guides this towards cover.
Similar delivery from Nasum Ahmed as Brandon King tries to guide this straight back once agin but finds the mid on fielder this time.
Full and on middle, Shamarh Brooks plays this to the right of the bowler and straight past the stumps. They take a single as the mid on fielder runs across to collect the ball.
Slightly short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks goes back and punches this towards mid on.
Flights this full and angling into middle. Shamarh Brooks works this back to the left of the bowler.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Brandon King lunges forward and blocks it out. A wicket-maiden from Mehidy Hasan!
This one angles in, loopy ball, around the pads. Brandon King leans and defends it out.
Shorter, outside off. Brandon King stays in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full, around middle. Brandon King blocks it out.
Brandon King is the next batter in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A peach of a delivery! A deserving wicket for Mehidy Hasan and West Indies have lost their second wicket. Tosses it up, full in length, this one lands around middle and spins away. Kyle Mayers prods forward and tries to block this but gets beaten. The ball goes on to hit the off stump. A big, big wicket for Bangladesh!
Beaten! Lovely delivery! A fuller one, spinning away, outside off. Kyle Mayers leans to drive but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes closer to the stumps from back of a length. Shamarh Brooks knocks this back to the bowler.
Short once again and outside off, Shamarh Brooks steps across the stumps and fends this towards cover-point.
Back-of-a-length delivery on middle, Shamarh Brooks flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length ball delivered wide from the stump. Shamarh Brooks does not go for it.
Full and angling away from the batter, Shamarh Brooks happy to let this one through to the keeper.
Shoriful Islam starts well on a good length angling in from off stump. Gets some extra bounce and Shamarh Brooks manages to get a inside edge onto his pads as he plays for it.
Shoriful Islam comes into the attack.
Leg bye! Shorter one, around middle. Shamarh Brooks looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off his thigh pads towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Short, outside off, shaping away. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
Shaping away, outside off, short in length. Shamarh Brooks punches it off the back foot through cover for a brace.
Around off, a length ball, Kyle Mayers shuffles across and works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Kyle Mayers blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Kyle Mayers stays in his crease and dabs it towards point.
Full, on middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Shorter, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives this and finds the fielder at cover.
Outside off, tad shorter. Shamarh Brooks tries to drive this one but he misses.
Shorter, outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards mid off.
On middle, fuller and slower, on middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Shorter one, spinning away. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards cover.
POWERPLAY 2 - Bangladesh will be allowed to keep four fielders outside the circle now till the 33rd over.
Outside off, shorter one. Shamarh Brooks guides it to point for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks looks to tuck this one but he misses.
Outside off, shorter one. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it to mid on.
On a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out off the back foot.
Flighted delivery bowled full and on off, Kyle Mayers defends this down the pitch.
Quicker delivery angled into the pads, Kyle Mayers works this towards square leg.
Nasum Ahmed goes full in line with the stumps, Kyle Mayers flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Straight delivery bowled full and outside off, Kyle Mayers fends it towards cover.
Full delivery in line with the stumps, Kyle Mayers comes forwards and guides it towards mid on.
Slightly short and on middle. Kyle Mayers works this towards mid on.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.
FOUR! Ful, down the leg side. Shamarh Brooks gets down on his knee and sweeps it past square leg for a boundary.
Shorter one, outside off. Kyle Mayers pushes it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Mehidy Hasan delivers this short and wide outside off, Kyle Mayers steps back and thrashes this through covers for a much needed bounday!
Fuller, on middle. Kyle Mayers blocks it out.
Slightly short and outside off, Kyle Mayers cuts it straight to point.
Back-of-a-length delivery turning in from outside off, Shamarh Brooks uses the depth of the crease and punches it through covers for a brace.
Nasum Ahmed fires this one down leg side, Shamarh Brooks tries to work this leg side and misses. Gets some pad on this one.
Quicker delivery bowled outside off, Shamarh Brooks stays back and fends this towards cover.
Full delivery and in line with the stumps, Shamarh Brooks stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Tosses this one full outside off, Shamarh Brooks leaves this one alone.
Full-length delivery in line with middle, Shamarh Brooks strides forward to defend and gets an inside edge towards the leg side.
Lovely delivery! Pulls his length back a tad, and this one spins away, outside off. Kyle Mayers gets beaten on the outside edge as he tries to block this.
Pitches it up again, on middle. Kyle Mayers pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery, around off. Kyle Mayers blocks it out watchfully.
Full, outside off. Kyle Mayers leans and blocks it out.
This one comes with the arm, shorter, one, down the leg side. Kyle Mayers looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit high on his pads.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Mehidy Hasan starts off with a loopy ball, around middle, spinning away. Kyle Mayers looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge in between the keeper and the first slip fielder towards third man for a boundary.
An early change! Mehidy Hasan comes into the attack.

Shout for an LBW! The finger goes up but Brooks reviews. Coming to the delivery - Nasum Ahmed delivers this full and angles into the pads. The ball thuds against the pads and Bangladesh are roaring in appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Shamarh Brooks reviews. There seems to be a gap between the bat and the ball. UltraEdge shows a lot of spikes as the bat seems to hit the pad as well but the third umpire reckons there is a spike when the ball passes the bat. The onfield umpire has to overturn his decision and the Bangladesh players are not happy. They surround the umpire and are protesting the decision but the third umpire's decision stands and the game has to go on.
Full and angled into the stumps. Nasum Ahmed bowls this slower in the air and Shamarh Brooks blocks this solidly.
Shorter length and angling down leg, Shamarh Brooks works this towards short fine leg.
A beauty! Tad fuller, outside off, spinning away. Shamarh Brooks leans to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge. Some turn there for Nasum Ahmed!
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Shamarh Brooks defends this back to the bowler.
Nasum Ahmed serves this short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks mistimes it towards covers.
On a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leans to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single. A wicket and 9 runs off Mustafizur Rahman's first over!
Tighter line this time! Around the fourth stump, length delivery. Shamarh Brooks lets that go through.
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another fuller ball, on the pads this time. Shamarh Brooks flicks it past square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Shamarh Brooks gets off the mark in style! An overpitched delivery, around off. Shamarh Brooks shows the full face of the bat and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Shamarh Brooks walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Mustafizur Rahman strikes on his very first delivery! A magnificent start for Bangladesh! They have got rid of the dangerous, Shai Hope. A fuller delivery, tailing back in, around middle and off. Shai Hope looks to drive this one but the ball goes off his inside edge, onto his pads, and then onto the stumps. West Indies are in trouble early on!
It will be pace from the other end as Mustafizur Rahman comes to bowl.
Changes the angle, and goes 'round the wicket. Bowls this fraction short on middle, Kyle Mayers works this towards covers.
WIDE! West Indies are off the mark with an extra. Nasum Ahmed bowls this short and angling down leg.
Back-of-a-length delivery spinning in from outside off, Kyle Mayers goes back in the crease and knocks it back to the bowler.
Fraction short and angling into the pads. Kyle Mayers guides this towards square leg.
Fires this one in into the pads, Kyle Mayers digs it out back to the bowler.
Similar delivery from outside off, Kyle Mayers goes on the back foot and plays it to covers.
Nasum Ahmed begins with a full delivery angling in from outside off, Kyle Mayers fends this off towards covers.

We are all set for action to begin! The players are out in the middle. They will all take the knee in support of the BLM movement. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers will open the batting for West Indies. Nasum Ahmed will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
It's time for the National Anthems! All the players are lined up for their respective anthems. It will be Bangladesh's first followed by that of West Indies'.

PITCH REPORT - Samuel Badree is near the pitch. He says that conditions are quite satisfactory, the concerns are near the inner circle as there were a few damp patches, but with the sun out, that should not be a problem. Adds that the pitch is quite firm, it is quite hard as well, with some grass on one side but bare patches on the other side. Adds that the start is very important, whoever gets to a good start will carry that momentum.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, when asked about their recent ODI form says that they need to stick to the process, build partnerships and win big moments. On his own batting performance, he says that he is not worried and will stick to his game and get through it. Says Gudakesh Motie will be making his debut and he is looking forward to seeing how he plays.

Tamim Iqbal the captain of Bangladesh says that they are going to bowl first, the pitch has been under cover for the past two days and they will try to restrict West Indies. Mentions that this a format they have done well, but nothing to take away from West Indies they have been terrific. Adds that his preparation has not been the best but he is hoping he can step up today. Informs that they are playing with 6 batters and 5 bowlers.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope, Kyle Mayers, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C/WK), Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd, Anderson Phillip, Jayden Seales, Gudakesh Motie (On debut), Akeal Hosein.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mahmudullah, Nurul Hasan (WK), Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Nasum Ahmed (On debut).
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

UPDATE - 8.46 pm IST (3.16 pm GMT) - We have some positive news! The outfield seems fine and we have a START TIME! The toss will be held at 8.50 pm IST (3.20 pm GMT), with play set to begin at 9.15 pm IST (3.45 pm GMT). The game has been reduced to 41 overs per side. One bowler can bowl 9 overs and 4 can bowl a maximum of 8 overs. Powerplay 1 will be between overs 1-8, Powerplay 2 between overs 9-33 and Powerplay 3 from 34-41. To bring you a squad update, Keemo Paul has tested positive for co-vid and in his place Romario Shepherd starts for West Indies.
